title: Happy Ghast Whistle
description: Call your Happy Ghast from far away using a goat horn! Hold the horn and your ghast will follow you like a snowball. Makes having a pet ghast actually usable and super fun!
body:
🎉 **Happy Ghast Whistle** lets you finally call your ghast buddy from across the world — no more chasing floating meatballs!

Just name a goat horn and name your Happy Ghast the **same name**. Blow that horn and your ghast will come flying to you from up to **12 chunks away**!

And it gets even better: While you're holding the named goat horn, your Happy Ghast with the matching name will follow you around like a loyal (and slightly derpy) balloon dog. Only the ghast with the right name will listen — perfect if you have multiple!

**✨ Features:**
- Call your named Happy Ghast from far away using a goat horn
- Up to 12 chunks of calling range
- Hold the horn to make your ghast follow you
- Works with as many named ghasts as you want
- Craft nametags in all Minecraft versions!
- Use the horn while crouching to make your ghast glow
- Super lightweight and simple

Whether you want your ghast to help light up caves, carry stuff, or just vibe with you while you explore, **Happy Ghast Whistle** makes having a pet ghast actually practical and a ton of fun!

Perfect for survival worlds, especially if you already have a Happy Ghast mod installed. Great for solo play or showing off on multiplayer servers.

Drop the mod in, name your horn and your ghast, and start whistling! Your floating friend is just one toot away. 🐌🎵
